blocks.html: Multi-pane glazed assemblies having individual panes not exceeding 1 square foot (0.09 m 2 ) in exposed areas shall have at least one pane in the assembly marked as indicated in Section 2406.3. Other panes in the assembly shall be marked "CPSC 16 CFR Part 1201" or "ANSI Z97.1", as appropriate.
